title: Five steps, and a person on the other end of each one
lead: Admissions are open for every grade from Nursery to Class XII, and for our BBA and BCCA degree programmes.
intro: We keep the process short and human. There is no entrance examination for the lower grades: what we want is to meet your child, understand where they are, and be honest with you about whether this is the right school for them.
Places in each grade are limited and are offered in the order enquiries are received and completed, so it is worth beginning early in the session.

steps.title: Send an enquiry
steps.description: Complete the online enquiry form, or call the school office.
detail: Tell us your child's name, date of birth and the grade you are seeking, and we will confirm availability in that grade.
The form takes about two minutes. Our admissions office replies to every enquiry within two working days.

steps.title: Visit the campus
steps.description: Come and see the school on a working morning.
detail: Walk the corridors, the laboratories and the ground while classes are running — a school on a quiet Sunday tells you nothing.
You will meet the section head and, wherever possible, the teacher who would teach your child.

steps.title: Interaction
steps.description: A short, informal conversation with your child.
detail: For Pre-Primary, this is simply play and conversation so we can see how your child settles.
For Grade I and above, a brief interaction in English, mathematics and reading tells us where to start, not whether to accept.

steps.title: Submit documents
detail: Birth certificate; transfer certificate and last progress report from the previous school (Grade I and above); recent passport-size photographs; Aadhaar copies for child and parent; proof of residence.
The office will confirm the exact list for your child's grade in advance so nothing needs a second trip.

steps.title: Confirm the place
steps.description: Fee payment and the start-of-term pack.
detail: On confirmation you will receive the fee structure for the session, the uniform and book requirement for the grade, and the term dates.
Your child's class teacher will contact you before the first day so that the first morning is not a cold start.

documents: Transfer certificate from the previous school (Grade I and above)
Latest progress report or mark sheet
Four recent passport-size photographs of the child
Aadhaar card copy — child and parent
Caste or category certificate, where applicable

eligibility.criteria: Completed 3 years as on the start of the academic session
Completed 4 years as on the start of the academic session
Completed 5 years as on the start of the academic session
Completed 6 years, with a transfer certificate from the previous school
Age-appropriate, subject to place availability and a transfer certificate
Class X result as per Maharashtra State Board norms
Class XII pass as per university eligibility norms
